summary: Entrywise: every entry is built from entries of Z⁻¹, W⁻¹, diagLast and a square root of a number in the slit plane.

steps.claim: A matrix-valued map is differentiable iff all its entries are: reduce to each entry (i, j).

steps.lean: have : ∀ i j, Differentiable ℂ (@diagLast 𝔰 · i j) := by simp [diagonal, eq_comm]
steps.claim: Each entry of diagLast(x) is a differentiable function of x (it is 1, 0 or x).
steps.typed_fact: ∀ i j, Differentiable ℂ (@diagLast 𝔰 · i j)

steps.lean:
simp_all only [uncurry, sectionMatrix, sectionFrame, sectionCoeff, invCorner,
    nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse, mul_apply,
    Matrix.add_apply, sub_eq_add_neg, Matrix.neg_apply]; fun_prop (disch := simp_all)
steps.claim: Unfolding sectionMatrix, sectionFrame, sectionCoeff and invCorner, each entry is a polynomial in the entries of Z, W, Z⁻¹, W⁻¹ (the matrix inverse is differentiable at invertible matrices) and of diagLast(s), diagLast(s⁻¹) with s = √(1 − ξ(Z)ξ(W)); by 3, 1 − ξ(Z)ξ(W) lies in the slit plane, where the square root is differentiable and nonzero; so every entry is differentiable (fun_prop).
